## Before merging

- [ ] Help updated, or the page's `reviewed:` date set (`scripts/help-touched origin/main` is clean)
- [ ] [PowerWhittle timeline](https://github.com/orgs/Power-Whittle/projects/1) updated: this
      pull request (or its issue) is on it with a start and target date, and its status is right
- [ ] Power-Whittle kept up to date where this change touches it (see
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#keep-power-whittle-up-to-date)), or nothing there
      needed a change
